szenen.text: Trump says he would do it again. Iran says Americans voted no to war. Who is right?
After his party lost the midterms, Trump said he does not regret the war. I did the right thing, he said.
Iran's chief negotiator Ghalibaf answered on X: Americans said no to war, and we endorse this message.
Iran's Guards say four tankers hit mines near the Strait of Hormuz. Still, Brent oil fell below 100 dollars for the first time since early October.
Mediators expect answers from both sides around Thursday. Oil moves inflation, and crypto reacts first. Deal or more strikes? Comment below.
